name: codex-creator
description: Create and review coherent Codex plugins and reusable skills with extensions to the canonical system creators.

interface.shortDescription: Design coherent plugins and reusable skills.
interface.longDescription: Extends the canonical system plugin-creator and skill-creator. Define plugin boundaries and bundled surfaces, keep manifests and usage guidance aligned, and design bounded skills with selection metadata and comparative behavioral validation. Canonical base skills are required and are not bundled.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-creator:plugin-creator to package a plugin and define the right bundled surfaces.

Use $codex-creator:skill-creator to design a reusable Codex skill with clear boundaries, references, guardrails, and description trigger metadata. Plan ordinary and failure-hypothesis use cases compared with and without the skill; design or review requests produce a validation plan, while execution stays within the authorized scope.
